concerns.text: T004 writes `EstimationResult` objects to `data/results/simulation_raw.jsonl`. T005 (later) also writes a combined JSON‑lines file to the same path, which will overwrite T004’s output and discard the bias/coverage records produced by T004. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer conflict for the final `simulation_raw.jsonl` artifact.

Because T005 re‑creates `data/results/simulation_raw.jsonl` after T004, the ordering should be reversed (run T005 first, then T004 to compute bias/coverage on the completed file) or T004 should write to a distinct artifact. As currently ordered, downstream tasks (e.g., T006‑T008) may consume an incomplete or overwritten file.
